description.value: BC Liquor Store is a government-operated retail liquor outlet in the Saanich area of Greater Victoria, part of the province-wide BCLIQUOR network run by BC's Liquor Distribution Branch. The store carries a broad selection of wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. For touring cyclists, it is a convenient stop to resupply with beverages on routes through the McKenzie Avenue corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 87m; informal at 94m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is a real, operating BCLIQUOR retail store; the store locator page loaded successfully and the About Us page confirms 198 stores operate province-wide under the BCLIQUOR brand. The store locator page content is partially dynamic/JavaScript-rendered, so specific store-level details (address, phone) could not be confirmed from the website text. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Store locator page appears partially JavaScript-rendered; store-specific address and phone could not be confirmed from fetched website text.
OSM name is 'BC Liquor Store' but the brand is marketed as 'BCLIQUOR' on the website — minor branding discrepancy, not a substantive concern.
OSM community field lists 'Victoria' but the website store page title reads 'SAANICH' — the address is in the District of Saanich, not the City of Victoria proper.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible government-operated retail store useful to touring cyclists for beverage resupply.
